Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/24313
Template Social-ext-Phishing: social Phishing via Email -> credentials; then the actor accessed the mailboxes (hacking Use of stolen creds). Assets P - End-user (3 employees) and S - Mail. Integrity Alter behavior. Government Regional (state agency); NAICS 921 -> 923120 (administration of public health programs). Count not given. Comments not reviewed. Employee count 1001 to 10000 (approximate).
Credentials added to attribute.confidentiality.data on 2026-11-19 per analyst rule: Hacking 'Use of stolen creds' requires Credentials as a compromised data variety (amount unknown).

summary: On July 21, 2026 the North Dakota Department of Health and Human Services identified a phishing email attack. Three employees in its Developmental Disabilities division interacted with the email, letting an external actor access their email accounts. A review finished August 14, 2026 found protected health information including names, contact details, dates of birth, service, health plan, medical and guardian information was accessed.
